title: Exceptional strict-system comparison and transport interfaces
statement: For strict etale coefficient systems with their normalized derived comparison [def-pur-coefficient-system-image-data], a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], its ordinary compact-support data [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces], and its exceptional adjoint [def-sf-strict-etale-exceptional-adjoint-interfaces], define the strict pro-etale compact-support and site-comparison interfaces. These retain the actual ordinary geometric inverse images, their adjunctions, exact-localization and universal right-derived factorization maps, normalized finite evaluations, and the bounded-below etale-origin subcategories. Define the proper/open comparison by the proper adjunction mate followed by open comparison, its origin comparison using the actual site counit, and the transported right functor by the literal site-direct/right-adjoint/site-inverse composite. The transport interface records the restricted Hom-chain adjunction, finite units and counits, quotient mates and transition equations, exactness, linearity, normalizedness and the uniform lower bound.
